title: Atoms, particulate nature & composition
mechanism: matter is composed of discrete particles whose identity and count fix its behaviour

title: Chemical amount / the mole
mechanism: a counting convention that bridges particulate count to macroscopic mass, volume and charge

title: Periodicity
mechanism: recurring electronic configuration produces recurring property trends

title: Bonding & molecular structure
mechanism: electrons are shared or transferred between nuclei to lower total energy

title: Structure–property relationships
mechanism: spatial and electronic arrangement determines observable property

title: Interparticle interactions, states & solutions
mechanism: attraction between particles competes with thermal motion

title: Chemical change & reaction mechanisms
mechanism: bonds break and form along a pathway that conserves atoms and charge

title: Reaction stoichiometry
mechanism: balanced equations fix mole ratios between species

title: Redox
mechanism: electrons transfer between species, changing oxidation state

title: Electrochemistry
mechanism: redox driven or resisted by an electrical potential difference

title: Energy & thermodynamics
mechanism: energy is conserved and redistributed; spontaneity is set by free energy

title: Equilibrium
mechanism: opposing processes reach equal rates, fixing a state ratio

title: Solubility equilibria
mechanism: dissolution and precipitation reach equal rates

title: Kinetics
mechanism: rate is governed by the barrier and the frequency of effective encounters
